Wonder

A wonder lasts but nine days and then the puppies’ eyes are opened.
No wonder lasts more than three days.
Italian.
Wonder is the daughter of ignorance.
Wonder is the first cause of philosophy.
Aristotle.
Wonder lasts but nine nights in a town.
